# Synthetic SMTP send — happy path. Wire is CRLF; AUTH string is a dummy.
S: 220 fake.kiwi-test.invalid ESMTP FakeKIWI
C: EHLO client.kiwi-test.invalid
S: 250-fake.kiwi-test.invalid
S: 250-STARTTLS
S: 250-AUTH PLAIN LOGIN
S: 250 SIZE 10485760
C: AUTH PLAIN AHRlc3QtdXNlckBma2Utd2lyZQ==
S: 235 2.7.0 Authentication successful
C: MAIL FROM:<alice@kiwi-test.invalid>
S: 250 2.1.0 Ok
C: RCPT TO:<bob@kiwi-test.invalid>
S: 250 2.1.5 Ok
C: DATA
S: 354 End data with <CR><LF>.<CR><LF>
C: From: alice@kiwi-test.invalid
C: To: bob@kiwi-test.invalid
C: Subject: synthetic hello
C:
C: Hello from the fixture.
C: .
S: 250 2.0.0 Ok: queued as FAKE0001
C: QUIT
S: 221 2.0.0 Bye
